summary: Iteration 12: model_year on bikes + lookup-with-year + year-aware photo filter + bicycle placeholder on empty-image bikes — all green. BACKEND: added /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_model_year.py (14 tests, 14/14 PASSED in ~46s). (1) GET /api/bikes includes model_year: all 3 Raymon bikes (Soreno Comp, Norza Comp, Vamok Pro) report '2027'; Focus Sam 6.9 (id 3be9a93d650142a4a08580c6deec6b01) reports '2026'. (2) POST /api/admin/bikes/lookup year validation: no-token→401, user-token→403, year='abcd'→422. (3) Lookup Focus Sam 6.9 with year='2026' returns 200 with keys {year='2026', year_confirmed:bool, image_url, source_url, description, description_en, specs:dict}; if year_confirmed=False then specs=={} (verified on the branch); byte-identical bike doc before/after (DB NOT mutated). (4) Enricher unit tests: _other_year('…/2024/review','2026')→True; _other_year('…/sam-6-9','2026')→False; _other_year with target year present→False; _other_year with 'my25' shorthand→False (regex only matches 20YY). _find_photo with year='2026' rejects an image URL containing only '2025' served from a page whose URL/title/meta do not mention 2026 (httpx mocked). (5) PUT /api/admin/bikes/{id} on a TEST_IT12_bike (created+deleted inside the test): sending model_year='2027' persists it; omitting model_year from the body keeps the previously stored '2026' (admin_update_bike only sets model_year when body.model_year is not None). FRONTEND (390x844): logged in admin@noleggionuovo.it/Admin2026! via /login (testID login-submit-button), opened /admin/bike-form?id=<focus>; testID bike-form-year shows '2026'; testID bike-form-search-online labeled 'Cerca di nuovo online' present and tappable; tap→button text cleared+aria-disabled=true (loading state), lookup completed in ~60s, description field repopulated with new Gemini text ('La Focus SAM² 6.9 è una e-mountain bike da downhill di alta gamma…'); bike-form-year-warning NOT shown (Gemini returned year_confirmed=true for 2026); navigated away WITHOUT tapping bike-form-save, re-GET /api/bikes/{id} byte-identical to pre-click snapshot (safety contract honored, DB not modified). Home catalog: Focus Sam 6.9 card renders testID bike-card-noimg-3be9a93d650142a4a08580c6deec6b01 (bicycle icon placeholder) because image_url is empty; detail page /bike/{id} also renders the bicycle-icon placeholder (same testID reused since the <Image> component is shared) and shows specs correctly. SAFETY: no bikes saved on real fleet, no bookings created, TEST_IT12_bike + TEST_user_<uuid> cleaned up.

issues: Detail page placeholder reuses testID 'bike-card-noimg-{id}' rather than a distinct 'bike-detail-noimg-{id}'. Not a bug (same component is likely shared), but a dedicated testID on the detail screen would make test discovery clearer. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: server.admin_update_bike (server.py:591) excludes 'model_year' from the generic $set and only sets it when body.model_year is not None → 'omitted → keep existing' semantics work. Verified. If an admin wants to CLEAR the model year, they must send '' which becomes None in Mongo (upd['model_year'] = body.model_year or None). Clean.
server.BikeIn.model_year (server.py:117) regex ^((19|20)\d{2})?$ accepts empty string (keep behaviour) and 4-digit years in 19xx/20xx. '2026' and '2027' fine; 'abcd'→422 (verified).

enricher._other_year (enricher.py:54-57) uses negative lookaround regex (?<!\d)(20[12]\d)(?!\d) so '2026' doesn't incorrectly match '12026'/'20260'. _find_photo (line 95) correctly rejects pages that mention only a different year (line 118: _other_year(page_url, year)) and images that mention only another year unless page is year-ok (line 126). Logic is correct.

sheet_sync.resolve_bikes (sheet_sync.py:170-174) sets model_year = the most-common 'Anno' value among the fleet units of the base model (max by count). This correctly handled Raymon→2027 and Focus→2026 in the live DB. If a shop lists a model with mixed years, the majority wins; minority units' real year is lost — acceptable per spec but worth noting.

frontend/bike-form.tsx:96 sends year=modelYear.trim()||null and exclude_image=imageUrl.trim()||null. Pydantic LookupIn.year is Optional[str] with pattern that also allows '' (empty capture group), so '' would be accepted; the frontend sends null for empty, which is cleaner. Fine.

frontend/bike-form.tsx:103 setYearWarning(!!r.year && !r.year_confirmed) — testID bike-form-year-warning appears only when a non-empty year was requested AND Gemini did not confirm it. For Focus Sam 6.9/2026 Gemini currently returns year_confirmed=true (verified live), so the warning does not render — expected. Spec compliant.

frontend/(tabs)/index.tsx:120-124 renders testID bike-card-noimg-{id} with Ionicons bicycle 64px over surfaceTertiary bg when image_url is empty. Verified live for Focus Sam 6.9. For the detail screen (/bike/[id]), the same component appears to be reused — if main agent wants an explicit testID 'bike-detail-noimg-{id}' they'd need to add one; not a blocker.
